name: Engineers
source:
Elderly brothers serving as engineers for the "Flying Pussyfoot."
Because they're hard of hearing, they couldn't hear the gunshots and commotion happening outside the engine room. Claire's periodic light signal from the caboose tricked them into keeping the train moving without stopping.
